description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelManageDelegatesButton class, which extends a base widget class to provide a button for managing delegate permissions in the UI of SuiteCRM. It primarily contains method to generate an HTML form with a button that triggers JavaScript function manage_delegates().

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelManageDelegatesButton
classes.description: A widget class to render a 'Manage Delegates' button in subpanels, extending the base widget for subpanel top buttons.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML for a form with a button that triggers the manage_delegates() JavaScript function, using label strings from the global mod_strings array.
